security_audit.summary: All 15 static findings are false positives involving Markdown syntax, public Cabinet Office URLs, a documentation link, and readable Japanese text. The documented commands retrieve and decode public CSV data without executing downloaded content. No evidence found of credential access, data exfiltration, destructive actions, or prompt injection in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - 文字コードは **Shift_JIS**。必ず `iconv` などでUTF-8に変換する。
- 1行目はヘッダー (`国民の祝日・休日月日,国民の祝日・休日名称`)。以降 `1955/1/1,元日` の形式。
- 振替休日・国民の休日もあらかじめ行として含まれている(名称は `休日`)。
- **タイムアウトを付ける**: `curl -sm 30` のように必ず制限時間を付ける。
- **`iconv` がない環境**: 代わりに Python を使う(ほぼどの環境にもある):
- 元データは内閣府の公開ページ (https://www8.cao.go.jp/chosei/shukujitsu/gaiyou.html)。CSVが更新されたら最新を取り直す。
- **CSVが取れない(HTTP 5xx、タイムアウト、空)**: 1〜2回再試行し、駄目なら「内閣府のサイトから祝日CSVを取得できなかった。https://www8.cao.go.jp/chos
共通の取得時チェックリストは [共通レスポンス契約](../docs/response-contract.md) の「取得時の落とし穴チェックリスト」を参照。

content.user_title: Find Japanese Holidays and Long Weekends
content.value_statement: Planning around Japanese holidays requires current dates and accurate weekend grouping. This skill guides holiday lookups and long weekend calculations using the Cabinet Office public CSV.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the Cabinet Office public holiday CSV without an API key or login.
Convert Shift_JIS holiday data to UTF-8 using iconv or a Python fallback.
Check whether a date appears in the official CSV and return its holiday name.
List holidays within a requested date range in chronological order.
Group weekends and listed holidays into breaks lasting at least three days.
Distinguish official CSV results from estimates for years not included in the dataset.
limitations: Official data covers 1955 through approximately the following year; later years may require estimates.
Personal schedules, calendar editing, and employer-specific closures are outside scope.
Retrieval requires network access, curl, and either iconv or Python.
The referenced shared response checklist is not included in the reviewed package.

use_cases.title: Plan Travel Dates
use_cases.description: Identify long weekends and their included holidays before selecting travel dates in Japan.

use_cases.title: Check Scheduling Conflicts
use_cases.description: Check proposed meeting dates against Japanese national holidays without treating employer closures as official holidays.

use_cases.title: Prepare Holiday References
use_cases.description: Build a chronological holiday list for a publication period using current official data.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Date
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether January 1, 2026 is a Japanese national holiday using the current Cabinet Office CSV. Return the date and holiday name.

prompt_templates.title: List Holidays
prompt_templates.prompt: List Japanese national holidays from [start date] through [end date] in chronological order. Identify any dates outside official CSV coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Find Long Weekends
prompt_templates.prompt: Find breaks of at least three consecutive days in [year], treating Saturdays, Sundays, and official holidays as days off. Include dates and holiday names.

prompt_templates.title: Separate Official Data From Estimates
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare long weekends in [year A] and [year B]. Verify CSV coverage first. Separate official results from estimates and explain assumptions.

output_examples.input: Is January 1, 2026 a Japanese national holiday?
output_examples.output: January 1, 2026: New Year's Day, a Japanese national holiday.

output_examples.input: Show the January 2026 long weekend around Coming of Age Day.
output: January 10 and 11 are Saturday and Sunday.
January 12 is Coming of Age Day.

output_examples.input: Can you update my personal calendar with these holidays?
output_examples.output: Personal calendar editing is outside this skill's scope. I can list Japanese national holidays for your requested period.

best_practices: Fetch current official data and verify the requested year is included before reporting confirmed holiday dates.
Decode the CSV correctly and apply a retrieval timeout before processing holiday names.
State weekend assumptions and label results outside official CSV coverage as estimates.
anti_patterns: Treating an old local CSV as current official data.
Presenting future-year estimates as confirmed official holiday dates.
Assuming every employer closes on all weekends and national holidays.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key or login?
faq.answer: No. It uses the Cabinet Office public holiday CSV without authentication.

faq.question: Which years does the official CSV cover?
faq.answer: The skill describes coverage from 1955 through approximately the following year. Check the downloaded data for the actual available range.

faq.question: Does the data include substitute holidays?
faq.answer: Yes. The CSV already includes substitute holidays and citizen's holidays, sometimes named simply as holidays.

faq.question: How does the skill identify long weekends?
faq.answer: It groups consecutive Saturdays, Sundays, and CSV-listed holidays, then returns groups lasting at least three days.

faq.question: Can it manage my calendar or workplace schedule?
faq.answer: No. Personal calendar operations and employer-specific schedules are outside scope.

faq.question: What happens when the CSV cannot be retrieved?
faq.answer: The instructions allow one or two retries, then report the failure and direct users to the official holiday page.
